rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter exactly: same cookieFilterAction reuse, Validate, module ID naming, Caddyfile switch, receiver conventions, and interface-guard entries.
rationale.edge_cases: Unparseable lines pass through, quoting preserved for replace and hash, suffix kept byte-for-byte, exact-name match, first-action-wins; whitespace-in-value handling is slightly odd but harmless.
rationale.scope: Only adds the new filter, registration and guards; no unrelated edits or refactors.
rationale.readability: Clear split into Filter/filterLine/replaceSetCookieValue; whitespace-preservation arithmetic and redundant name/quote re-checks add some noise.
rationale.robustness: All slice indices are guarded, ParseSetCookie errors handled, non-array fields returned untouched; no panic paths.
rationale.maintainability: Reuses shared action type and hash helper; Caddyfile parsing is copy-pasted from CookieFilter rather than shared, but that follows the stated convention.
